4022.text: We can assume, then, that they have the means to cross the ocean.

4025.text: The Kirin Tor agrees. This is not a matter of military might or political influence, we need a unifying presence. A presence experienced with this sort of threat.

4028.text: A wise decision. The Kirin Tor stands behind you.

4034.text: There’s wisdom to your words, Lord Antonidas. Kul Tiras owns the seas, and I am ready to lead our fleets into battle if need be, but to command…

4037.text: Kul Tiras agrees with this assessment. Sir Lothar is the perfect choice.

4040.text: Why move south if the Horde is concentrated between the capital and Dalaran?

4046.text: Understood, Commander. We will march to Southshore today.

4049.text: I won’t fail you, Commander Lothar.

4052.text: You are telling us to prepare for war then?!

4055.text: Our shores have long stood vigil over this continent, and we’ve thrown all sorts of pirates back into the sea. I am certain we can do so again. I don’t see the necessity of unifying our armies into a single force.

4058.text: So, you have come to claim sovereignty over us?

4061.text: Gilneas shall honor the pact, Lord Lothar. We will provide any troops, armor, weaponry, food we can spare.

4064.text: Your Grace, the survivors of Stormwind.

4070.text: My lord. I have sent ravens to Dalaran and Lordaeron. Lord Antonidas is already aware of the scale of the threat, and I believe he will convince King Terenas to summon the lords of the remaining kingdoms.

4079.text: Thank you, Mayor Marcus. I understand you can’t spare much, but we are grateful for any aid.

4085.text: We must not delay, Khadgar. I must speak with the king at once. We dare not give the Horde time to move again.

4094.text: Your Majesty, I am Anduin Lothar, Knight-Champion of Azeroth and a close friend to the late King Llane. And these are my companions…

4097.text: …we come before you to discuss a matter of grave and urgent importance!

4103.text: It fell before a Horde of creatures known as orcs.

4109.text: I do not know, but even if they did not have ships before, they certainly will have them soon — they raided all along our coastline and captured our wharfs. They can and will use them to build more ships.

4112.text: Yes, a war for the very survival of our race.

4115.text: We need to begin massive war preparations.

4118.text: Your Majesties, we’ve told you, these are no mere raiders, this is death riding on dark tides! You will not be able to withstand them on your own, only together, all of us!

4133.text: Danath, I need you to travel south with a small squad of your troops. Check the situation in Southshore.

4139.text: Trust me, Danath. I am already preparing necessary actions to aid and secure them.

4145.text: Of course, Lord Lothar. We wouldn’t let women and children starve. But tell me now, why have you and your people fled across the sea? What happened in Azeroth?

4148.text: Lordaeron City is no short distance! I will send someone ahead on a fast horse to warn them of your approach.

4151.text: And as for your people here, we will take care of them until you return.

4160.text: Such a haste for a gathering unseen in decades. You better have important reasons indeed, I missed a royal hunt.

4166.text: If the majority agrees, so do I.

4172.text: You seem discouraged, my lord… What happened?

4175.text: Yet we managed to save Tyr's Hand. And Andorhal.

4181.text: Your Majesty. As lord of this land, I offer my hospitality and protection to you. The heir of Azeroth deserves no less.

4184.text: You must know, I grieved when I learned the news of your noble father’s death. King Llane was a good man and we counted him as a friend and an ally. Know that we shall do all in our power to restore you to your throne.

4187.text: You bear the royal sigil of Azeroth, yet I do not know who you are. Are you the prince’s protector?

4190.text: Ah, Lord Lothar… you are of a proud and ancient bloodline, and your reputation precedes you. You shall have your audience.

4193.text: You must be tired, your Majesty. Let’s take rest in the palace.

4196.text: Thank you all for coming, I know the request seemed sudden, but we have matters of grave importance to discuss and time seems to be of the essence.

4202.text: My lords! Lord Lothar, please continue. I have been to Stormwind before, and I admired its grandness and strength. What could destroy such a city?

4205.text: While the kingdoms are assembling their armies, I will send a small scouting force to the island of Zul’Dare, to evaluate if the Horde has made any attempts to cross the Great Sea yet.

4211.text: Of course not. I am merely saying the command of our unified forces should not be decided lightly.

4214.text: Indeed… I agree. As the champion of Azeroth, Lord Lothar spent years battling the orcish hordes. His experience alone is invaluable.

4223.text: We the kings of the Alliance do hereby appoint Lord Anduin Lothar, Champion of Azeroth, as our Supreme Commander!

4226.text: Orcs? Are they some kind of trolls? And where did this horde come from? As far as I know, you have dealt with the trolls of the southern jungles before.

4232.text: On that I agree Sir Lothar. However, if we are to establish this union, I only see fit that I lead it to battle!

4237.text: I admit that is a wise choice, but Lordaeron and Dalaran require our help right now.

4241.text: You will take charge of settling our people in this region. Make sure everything is in order until we return.

4242.text: Your Majesties, I thank you for attending this meeting, and for listening to what I have to say. I am no poet or diplomat but a warrior, so I will keep my words brief and blunt. I must tell you that my home, Stormwind, is no more.

4246.text: Yes, but we have lost Stromgarde, Tol Barad, Stratholme and much, much more…

4247.text: But this is no time to ponder. Willhelm, travel north, reach Commander Turalyon. It’s imperative he reinforces the capital’s defenses as soon as possible.

4249.text: I will do my best, Lord Lothar.

4250.text: I present to you Anduin Lothar, Champion of Stormwind. He has come here as a messenger. I think it best if I let him tell you himself what he has seen and what we may soon expect ourselves.

4251.text: Do I need to remind at whose behest are we here? Who sponsored this council from the beginning? We need more than a mere battle commander, we need someone who can unite us.

4253.text: And his bloodline. My ancestors fought beside Thoradin before, it would be a great honor to do so again by following his descendant.

4293.text: One week later — Capital City of Lordaeron.

4301.text: Southshore, one month after the fall of Stormwind Keep.

4323.text: Three years of bloody war have devastated the Eastern Kingdoms. Ironforge is under siege, the forests of Quel'Thalas burn with dragonfire, and countless cities lie in ruins.

4327.text: Kul Tiran and Gilnean forces remain isolated in their coastal enclaves. The capitals of Lordaeron and Dalaran are besieged by the Horde.

4328.text: Meanwhile, Anduin Lothar gathers his forces in Andorhal, rallying after a fierce battle with orcish raiders…

4332.text: Indeed. The township of Soutshore, between Dalaran and Alterac.

4334.text: What bureaucratic nonsense, Aiden! If you can't take responsibility, then leave it to those who can.

4335.text: I admit that the situation is serious, but I need to consult with my lawmakers and ministers before I can subscribe to any kind of war. This is how things are done in civilized kingdoms.

4336.text: I see where you are going…If I may, great leaders. When Northshire was decimated by the foul magic of orcish warlocks, we despaired. And when King Llane fell and Stormwind burned, we lost all hope.

4337.text: No trolls, Your Grace. They are an alien race, who have invaded our lands through a magical rift hidden somewhere within the southern fringes of the Black Morass.

4338.text: Know this — the Horde will not stop at Stormwind. They mean to claim the entire world, and they have the might and the numbers to do so. Nor do they lack magical powers.

4339.text: I just received a message that the Cross Island has fallen. It means that the Horde has reached Lordamere Lake. Seems like Alterac forces cannot defend their borders anymore… Since the beginning of this war, fortune has been against us.

4340.text: We will secure Hillsbrad and cut orcish supply lines from the sea. Then we will hit Doomhammer’s army from the rear.

4341.text: Now then, we have all agreed that time is of the essence if we are to marshal our united forces and meet the Horde when it arrives.

4342.text: Then I hereby declare the founding of the Grand Alliance of Lordaeron!

4344.text: They are terrible foes, as tall as a man and far stronger, with bestial features, green skin, and red eyes.

4347.text: Once they have finished with my homeland, they will find a way to cross the ocean and come for the rest of you.

4350.text: Yet there was one man who rallied us and led us through darkness. Anduin Lothar.

4353.text: We shall stand together as one, as our ancestors did long ago, in the Arathi Empire. And it is only fitting, then, that our commander should hail from that ancient ruling stock.

4356.text: Do we also agree upon our course of action?

4359.text: We have been chasing Doomhammer across the continent, never to arrive in time…

4362.text: This time, we will not play his game. Instead of chasing him, we’ll place a noose around the neck of his blasted Horde… and hang them with it.

4364.text: A proper landing site…. Are we in Lordaeron?

4365.text: Gavinrad. You will travel south with Captain Danath and provide support to his forces. After that, you will remain there and oversee the region in case the Horde attempts to flee east through Alterac. If you spot them - show no mercy.

4366.text: This is great honor for me. I accept this charge. With your aid, noble kings, we will vanquish the Horde and spare your people from the gruesome fate of Stormwind!

4367.text: You say they are coming here. Do they have ships?

3859.text: Your Majesty, we must abandon the palace and retreat to the courtyard. There, we can make our final stand and fortify our defenses.

3880.text: My King, you'll be safe here. I'll reinforce the city's defenses.

3883.text: Father, are those creatures going to kill us?

3898.text: Just in time, brother. We have much to do.

3907.text: We've done it! The orcs are falling back!

3910.text: Don't celebrate just yet... Look, the dragons are attacking the palace!

3928.text: You arrived just in time, my dwarven friend. The city would have been reduced to ashes if not for your aid.

3934.text: How far is Lord Lothar from the city?

3937.text: He's not heading here. His army is marching through Hillsbrad to relieve Dalaran and attack the orcs from the rear. If all goes as planned, the Horde will be caught between our forces here and his forces down south.

3949.text: In that case, we should concentrate our efforts on the lower city.

3952.text: I've had enough rest. It's time to crush some orcish skulls.

3955.text: Huh, so you can also fight and not just talk Bronzebeard?

3973.text: To achieve final victory over their remaining forces, we must cross the lake, assault Fenris Isle, and capture their generals.

3976.text: Ah, with all due respect to Master Proudmoore and his sea warriors, dwarves can never feel comfortable on any kind of boat. But then again, it's better than to ride a gryphon.

3979.text: Your wounds need more time to heal, my friend. You've already done a lot to ensure our victory here.

3991.text: Warchief, the humans have retaken the city! What do we do?

3994.text: We must press the attack! Those dogs deserve no reprieve!

4009.text: Yes, Warchief. But what of our base here?

4018.text: Puny humans, too stupid. Warchief said you die, so you die.

4048.text: Muradin, I want you to stay with me. You've shed enough blood for Lordaeron already, and I don't want to face the wrath of your brother-king if something were to happen to you.

4051.text: Your words warm my heart, King Terenas.

4070.text: I’ll crack yer skulls! Savage beasts!

4071.text: Lads! Do not let them advance further!

4075.text: Agreed. But first, we must get my son from his chambers!

4076.text: Arthas, my son, thank the Light you are safe. We're leaving the palace.

4077.text: The might of the mountains shall destroy ye!

4078.text: Fear not, Arthas. We are safe, for now. But if we are overrun, seek out the catacombs and join Prince Varian in the hideout.

4080.text: If you hadn’t reached us in time, I’m afraid all would’ve been lost, young Paladin. Your aid is sorely needed.

4081.text: Tell us what to do, Lord Uther.

4083.text: Those winged beasts are too formidable... we can't vanquish them all...

4084.text: Anduin Lothar helped us defend our homeland against the orcish scum. Now we’ll return the favor by ridding the city of greenskin mongrels.

4085.text: A solid plan. Now we must ensure we hold our defense here.

4086.text: First, we need to cleanse the last two city districts of those unholy creatures. March on!

4087.text: Blast it, their armada is too formidable for my gryphon pack. I can't take them all head on; there are too many ships!

4088.text: You can follow if you can keep up.

4090.text: The Lord Admiral sent me with the northern armada as soon as he received reports of the siege. Blessed be the sea; we have arrived in time.

4091.text: Your help is much appreciated. Without the might of Kul Tiras, this naval blockade could have held on for who knows how long.

4095.text: No. Between Dalaran and Alterac, our forces are stretched too thin. And the Alliance has further reinforcements on the way. We need to sound a tactical retreat, fall back, and regroup.

4097.text: We can’t hope to hold it. Not without committing troops we can’t spare right now. But we can leave the humans a surprise…

4102.text: My remaining ships are at your disposal, Your Majesty.

4122.text: Enough! That’s a command! Tharbek, you will oversee that our retreat is orderly. Utok, you will travel to our base at Zul’Dare and make sure our western supply lines remain intact. Is that clear?

4127.text: Ah, my treasury. It used to be full of gold…

167.text: Great masters, welcome. If I may, let me…

173.text: Chief Artificer? Dead? Without his constructs and our outlying defenses, how can we hope to stop their onslaught?

176.text: I am afraid we will need to improvise.

179.text: Improvise? They have dragons. We need more than that against such a power!

185.text: As you wish. But what of Master Norlan’s now-vacant position on our council?

188.text: There’s no time to debate that now. But worry not, I have a candidate in mind. She might be young, but her talents are unquestionable…

224.text: Modera’s the name. I am…was the personal assistant to Master Norlan…

230.text: Thank you. But we have more pressing matters at hand. The Horde’s artillery is tearing down our defenses…

233.text: And the Kirin Tor wants me to take it down. How?

236.text: This scroll will allow you to take on an appearance of one of their own. Unless you trigger one of their magical sentries, that should be enough to get past their lines.

239.text: Well, let’s hope the enchantment itself is reliable.

242.text: Don’t worry, I’ve made it myself.

254.text: Lets just throw everything we have at them!

260.text: Master Krasus. The orcish artillery has been dealt with as requested…

269.text: Yes, but first, we need to secure our defense perimeter. They can’t reach the inner parts of the city.

278.text: And there’s more to come. Our sentries report the orcs are massing for another attack. Headed by none other than their necromantic undead…

281.text: The ones that ravaged Stratholme and Quel’Thalas…the death knights.

284.text: Hmm. Thankfully, my studies have allowed me to design a potent spell that should protect us from their necromantic magic. However, I’ll need protection while invoking it.

287.text: I’ll leave that to Khadgar. There’s something strange about these dragons. How can the orcs control such once-majestic creatures? I - We need to learn more about it.

293.text: Curious…utmost curious. This will require further research.

299.text: You want to attack them head on?

302.text: No. We merely need to capture a few of them and force the rest back.

308.text: Just so. These leviathans are too powerful a weapon of war. We need to learn more about the magic the orcs use to control them. Otherwise, they might always pose a threat to us. And the best way to do so is to capture and study some of them.

314.text: Elves don’t need luck, my young friend.

323.text: Good riddance. It was about time we cleaned the city of this vermin.

329.text: Khadgar! Good to see you in one piece, master mage.

332.text: Likewise, commander. I take it you have secured the lake?

338.text: Thank you. The Horde’s offensive has been broken, yet there’s still a significant force beyond the river. It’s only a matter of time before they regroup and renew their assault…

347.text: The old man always keeps his word.

350.text: Good to see you, lads. Like I promised, I’ve brought some friends.

353.text: I am surprised to see so many Gilneans with you, sir. I thought King Greymane had a different strategy in mind…

356.text: Sometimes, strategies have to be adjusted. And not all of us agree with His Majesty and their brilliant mind.

362.text: We’ll have time to discuss this later. We have the orcs on the run. It’s time to finish this.

371.text: The orcs are retreating. The city is safe. But we must still measure the real cost of life. The level of damage is…considerable. Their dark powers have done their work.

374.text: We should have slaughtered them all for what they did to my homeland.

377.text: At least we can now learn more of their dominion over the dragons.

383.text: But there’s another matter to attend. Master Norlan’s passing has left his seat on the council vacant. And I believe young Master Modera to be a proper choice for his replacement.

392.text: All your forces are accounted for?

395.text: Yes, sir. Lordamere has been fully secured and Lordaeron is better manned than before the siege. And more reinforcements are on their way to Dalaran.

401.text: There were moments I thought I’d fail…

404.text: Have faith. You need to trust yourself. Just as we trust in you. I never doubted you, lad.

410.text: If this region is to be fully safe, we need to restore our control over the southern coasts. Zul’Dare must fall. I’ll take my vanguard and march south on Hillsbrad. You and your forces will remain here and protect our northern flank.

756.text: Calm down, masters. We’ve received a word that Doomhammer has been defeated at Lordaeron, and we’ll be soon reinforced by Alliance armies. The young Khadgar has delivered the report himself. We only need to hold our ground.

758.text: Drenden, rendezvous with Master Khadgar. His battlefield experience will be useful in coordinating our efforts.

760.text: Pathetic mortals, in the end, all shall feel the touch of death’s embrace!

762.text: As the Kirin Tor is occupied with other tasks, we require someone to take care of our troops and battlefield defenses. Given your extensive experience, you seem to be the most fitting choice.

763.text: Understood. But first, I need more soldiers.

764.text: Indeed. Our infantry and archer regiments are at your disposal. As this district has already been damaged by the Horde’s bombardment, you will need to use our workforce and resources to repair its structures.

765.text: That will be a heartbreaking sight. I have always loved those trees. But it can’t be helped, the survival of our city is at stake.

766.text: We must secure one of our blacksmiths, our troops need to repair and refine their armor and weaponry.

767.text: The outer gates and water barriers protect us from ground attacks, but with our magical defenses weakened, orcish warlocks can open portals to assail the city directly.

768.text: With these portals active, even the Violet Citadel itself is in danger. You must do whatever you can to protect it from their assaults.

769.text: The city banks are open to you, take anything you need. You are also free to scour for any lumber hidden in crates and barrels. If need be, cut even park trees down.

771.text: These wretched humans are bolstering their defenses, holding even against our relentless bombardment!

772.text: No, you fool! We must break the dam! Once the water levels have fallen, we flank their forces!

773.text: What a cruel sight. Such majestic creatures enslaved by the orcs…

775.text: These undead are wearing the armor of the Stormwind Knights. What a depravity.

777.text: I need to set up a diversion before my disguise fades. I’d better hurry, it won’t last a whole day.

778.text: I need to avoid any violence, they would surely discover and kill me otherwise.

2829.text: Next morning, Anduin Lothar and Danath Trollbane reached Hillsbrad.

2830.text: Wilhelm and Meryn were laid to rest near the town, their sacrifice honored so that their heroism would be remembered for generations.

2843.text: I was at the Warchief’s side in all his battles! I know his strategies — you can’t outsmart me!

2853.text: You think it’s easy to defeat and kill me? Bloodscribes — attack!

2855.text: I can leap to the archers on the wall. Danath, take care of the grunts down here.

2861.text: Argh… I’m grievously wounded… I can’t continue the fight, my lord…

2863.text: I can use that flagpole to jump from the wall.

2865.text: I’m badly wounded… You need to finish this without my aid, lad…

2867.text: By the authority of the Alliance of Lordaeron, I order you — open this gate and surrender your weapons!

2869.text: Empty words, orc! We have destroyed your forces!

2871.text: Yes… and you’ve thrown away your soldiers like kindling on a dying fire. That pathetic line behind the gate? They won’t save you — not when I’m standing over your shattered skull!

2876.text: Flags to put in a circle:

2878.text: Flags to put in a circle:

2885.text: The gates are shut. Wilhelm! Danath! Charge!

2919.text: Burn it to the ground. The main orc in the fortress will be left without resources.

2924.text: Soldiers! The Lion of Azeroth calls! To battle!

2935.text: Then let’s destroy them. We cannot prepare our invasion force with our rear exposed.

2944.text: Too quiet… We've only faced scattered patrols. Where are the rest of their forces?

2947.text: Stay vigilant. We must be ready for anything.

2965.text: My lord, some orcish forces remain entrenched along the eastern shore.

2969.text: No sign of Doomhammer. But these banners… I don’t recognize them.

2973.text: They tortured the soldiers we sent here a year ago… We will make them pay for this.

2985.text: So many corpses... The entire town has been slaughtered.

2986.text: Some time later, Alliance ships entered the waters of the Channel Islands.

2988.text: A troll destroyer ship. Seems like we’re going to have a naval fight.

2990.text: Good thing we were wise enough to build and prepare our own ships — weren’t we?

2994.text: Captain, you have both eyes in place — tell me, what's that brown spot in the fog?

2998.text: As we navigate through the Channel Islands, the shores of Zul’Dare draw near. Our destination is within sight.

3000.text: Lordaeron… but not the first time for humanity. The Horde is a blight that seeks to turn the entire continent into burning cinders…

3001.text: I am ready to face them! Both my sword and bow thirst for orcish blood!

3003.text: We have to harvest and refine oil for our ships as well. There might be troll destroyers in the nearby waters.

3004.text: I sense the vile stain of necromancy. The victims of the orcish slaughter find no rest.

3005.text: May the dead find solace in the hereafter.

3007.text: We are the Bloodscribe Clan! The Warchief has tasked us with protecting this island — and we shall! Your deaths will be a fitting sacrifice in his name!

3009.text: Stromgarde, Lordaeron, Quel’Thalas— I saw them all burn! What chance do you have?!

3010.text: Shut up, orc! You’d better save your breath for when we cross blades!

3022.text: Lord Crowley is approaching Hillsbrad from the west. He’s ready to join us when we give the signal. Whatever awaits us there, we must retake Hillsbrad. Danath, sound the attack. Wilhelm, with me!

3023.text: And in bad shape. The naval facilities have been completely destroyed. We must rebuild them and prepare an assault force before Zul'Dare can be taken.

3024.text: Aye. Scout the area for any enemy ships, build up our naval infrastructure, and ready our forces for battle. You have your orders, men!

3025.text: Then we must find their bodies, consecrate them, and grant them the peace they deserve.

3026.text: These waters must be cleansed if we are to secure our perimeter.

3027.text: Very well. Gavinrad, I want you to stay behind and defend Hillsbrad from any possible incursion — and keep an eye on our elven friend.

3028.text: Your skills are needed here in Hillsbrad, elf. We shall reconvene once our task is done.

3031.text: We have you cornered, orc. There’s no point in fighting back now. Surrender — and tell me, where’s your Warchief?!

3032.text: He has fallen in battle… gave his life for Azeroth — for me. He was a brave lad, an able soldier, and a loyal man. Much like Meryn. We must remember them as such.

3033.text: I need to ride north — to rendezvous with Turalyon and confer with the High Command. Someone needs to check on those damned royals. And there’s an old acquaintance of mine I have to meet…

3034.text: Don’t worry about it. You’ll hear from me soon enough. In the meantime, gather your forces and get some rest. You’ll need it — there’s a lot of work to do…

3046.text: These wretched orcs are forcing us to work day and night!

3058.text: In the name of King Trollbane and the Kingdom of Stromgarde — for the crimes you committed against my people… my family… I hereby sentence you to die.

3063.text: Danath, sound the signal to our allies!

3071.text: The Magistrate of Hillsbrad. Not even gold saved the bastard, and his folly cost Meryn his life.

3073.text: This town marks the site where the greenskins first unleashed their true barbarity on the lands of Lordaeron. And it still reeks of death and decay.
